# Hollin Hill Running Club: Tuesday attendance

A normal Tuesday run, March to October, has between 11 and 14 runners.

This year we added a monthly timed 5k on the riverside loop, in place of the normal run. Two so far:

- 11 March, dry and mild: 23 runners, 9 of them not members.
- 13 May, heavy rain all day: 8 runners, no visitors.

June poll of members (19 replies): 12 like the timed 5k, 4 dislike being timed, 3 do not mind.
